data.subject: Public-record signals on PESI, CDZI, and PCYO
data.body:
Hi,

Potomac's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PESI, CDZI, and PCYO.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue based only on public records and can offer Potomac a four-week fund pilot. Reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Andrew
